band-formats.answer: The 2002 DELETE has one format (§2002:14.8.9.1: DELETE file-name-1 RECORD, retry-phrase, INVALID KEY phrases, END-DELETE), identical to 2023 Format 1 (record); 2023's Format 2 (DELETE FILE) has no 2002 counterpart. The 2023 band FORMAT 1 reaches every 2002 DELETE. The twin witnesses pb144_indexed_delete_record and w73b_pb1194_mutation_open_mode_first re-run now PASS at --std 2002.
